payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

condition.question: Is the original blue mug from the source visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
condition.criteria: Compare the SOURCE and EDITED images, tracking the source blue mug by its visible appearance and context. Fulfillment requires that this same mug—not a different or newly appearing mug—be visibly positioned to the right of the headphones. A mug appearing on the right does not establish fulfillment if the source mug is not shown there. Score partial only when the tracked source mug shows concrete movement toward the right of the headphones but has not reached that position; if identity or continuity cannot be determined from the images, treat the evidence as insufficient.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: track that mug by its blue appearance and visual context; distinguish it from the white mugs. Assess whether the source mug itself is visibly to the right of the headphones, rather than counting a different mug or a blurred remnant as the moved mug.
condition.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
condition.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
condition.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
condition.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
condition.zero_when: The source blue mug is not shown to have moved toward the right of the headphones; a different mug on the right or unrelated edits do not count.
condition.half_when: The source blue mug is visibly tracked and has moved toward the right of the headphones, but remains short of being positioned to their right, with a concrete remaining positional deficiency.
condition.full_when: The source blue mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image.
